brief.text: Quiero un personaje de cuerpo completo con ropa convincente, una silueta propia y animaciones de caminar, frenar y girar vistas desde distintos ángulos, sin deslizamiento de pies.

researched: sculpted/modelled humanoid in Blender from editable mesh
decision.chosen: CC0 rigged GLB, independent of primitive-body procedural geometry
decision.reason: Full-body outfit already modelled and rigged, legal, dedicated walking clip, all-angle view; Blender unavailable in current runtime, 2.5D lacks free side/back rotation
limitations: glb is loaded from pinned external domain; preview is not self-contained
foot planting is runtime heuristic until observed with actual asset bone poses
90deg turning is authored at runtime, not a native distinct GLB turn clip

provenance: Original asset linked, not modified or rehosted

runtime.motion: foot-bone contact anchoring when both foot bones exist
